== Overview ==

'''Imajuku Ōtsuka Kofun''' (今宿大塚古墳) is a {{ill|Kofun|en|Kofun|qid=Q1141225|lt=Kofun}} located in {{ill|Nishi-ku|ceb|Nishi-ku|de|Nishi-ku|eo|Kvartalo Niŝi-ku|es|Nishi-ku|fr|Nishi-ku|hu|Nisi-ku (egyértelműsítő lap)|id|Nishi-ku|it|Nishi-ku|ja|西区|ko|니시구|th|เขตนิชิ|uk|Район Нісі|vi|Nishi-ku|qid=Q296095|lt=Nishi-ku, Fukuoka}}, {{ill|Fukuoka|en|Fukuoka|qid=Q26600|lt=Fukuoka}}, {{ill|Fukuoka Prefecture|en|Fukuoka Prefecture|qid=Q123258|lt=Fukuoka Prefecture}}.<ref>{{Cite web|和書|title=福岡市 今宿大塚古墳（今宿古墳群） |url=https://www.city.fukuoka.lg.jp/nishiku/c-shinko/charm/nisikunotakara/imajuku_otuka_kofun.html |website=福岡市 |access-date=2022-07-15 |language=ja}}</ref>  

Located on a '''low plateau''' at the northern foot of {{ill|Mount Takasu|ceb|Takasu Yama (bukid sa Hapon, Fukuoka-ken)|ja|高祖山|lld|Mont Takasu|zh|高祖山|qid=Q18337213}}, this kofun is a '''mid-6th century''' {{ill|Zenpō-kōen-fun|ja|前方後円墳|ko|전방후원분|simple|Zenpō-kōen-fun|zh|前方後圓墳|qid=Q11268718|lt=Zenpō-kōen-fun}}, with its front section facing '''west'''.<ref>{{Cite web|和書|title=今宿古墳群（大塚古墳） {{!}} 文化財情報検索 |url=https://bunkazai.city.fukuoka.lg.jp/cultural_properties/detail/item_id:101016 |website=福岡市の文化財 |access-date=2022-07-15 |language=ja}}</ref> It is part of the {{ill|Imajuku Kofun Group|ja|今宿古墳群|qid=Q103946619}} and was Historic Site1 as a '''National Historic Site''' on '''February 7, 1928''', with an additional Historic Site on '''April 5, 2004'''.<ref>{{Cite web|和書|title=国cultural property等データベース |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/2614 |website=kunishitei.bunka.go.jp |access-date=2022-07-15}}</ref>

== burial ==

This kofun has a '''total length of 64 meters''', with a '''long axis running east-west'''. It is built using a '''two-tiered construction method'''.<ref name="pYzG-2">{{Cite book|和書|author=Supervised by Itoshima District Social Education Promotion Association, Cultural Department |title=Ito Country Archaeological Guidebook |publisher=Itoshima Newspaper Co., Ltd. |date=2001 |page=100 |isbn=}}</ref>

In '''1977''', the kofun was '''covered with grass''' to preserve its type. A '''moat''' surrounds the mound.<ref>{{Cite book|和書|title=Imajuku Chamber of Commerce 60th Anniversary Commemorative Journal |publisher=Imajuku Chamber of Commerce |date=1990 |page=1 |isbn=}}</ref> The kofun and its surroundings have been developed into '''Ōtsuka Kofun Park'''.

== excavations ==

Pottery from '''{{ill|Yeongsan River|arz|نهر يونچسان|ceb|Yeisan|de|Yeongsan|es|Río Yeongsan|fr|Yeongsan (fleuve)|ja|栄山江|ko|영산강|pl|Yeongsan-gang|ru|Йонсанган|vi|Yeongsan|wuu|荣山江|zh|荣山江|qid=Q489956|lt=Yeongsan River}}-style''' kilns has been discovered at the site.<ref>{{Cite book|和書|author=Fukuoka City History Editorial Committee |title=City History Research: Fukuoka, Vol. 13 |publisher=Fukuoka City Museum |date=2018 |page=91 |isbn=}}</ref> Other finds include:
* '''[[Cylindrical Haniwa|Cylindrical haniwa]]''', '''warrior haniwa''', and '''horse-shaped haniwa''' found in the outer embankment  
* '''Sue pottery''' and other ceramics<ref>{{Cite web|和書|title=福岡市 今宿大塚古墳（今宿古墳群） |url=https://www.city.fukuoka.lg.jp/nishiku/c-shinko/charm/nisikunotakara/imajuku_otuka_kofun.html |website=福岡市 |access-date=2022-07-15 |language=ja}}</ref>  

The burial chamber remains '''uninvestigated'''.<ref name="pYzG-2"/>

== Access ==

=== By train ===  
* '''{{ill|Chikuhi Line|en|Chikuhi Line|qid=Q1042132|lt=Chikuhi Line}}''' – 15-minute walk from '''{{ill|Imajuku Station|en|Imajuku Station|qid=Q5368227|lt=Imajuku Station}}'''<ref>{{Cite web|和書|title=今宿大塚古墳 {{!}} 福岡観光地検索 |url=http://www.crossroadfukuoka.jp/event/?mode=detail&id=4000000000458&isSpot=1 |website=福岡県観光情報 クロスロードふくおか |access-date=2022-07-15 |language=ja}}</ref>

=== By bus ===  
* '''{{ill|Nishitetsu Bus|ja|西鉄バス|ko|니시테쓰 버스|qid=Q11629843}}''' – about '''400m from "Nishi Police Station-mae" stop'''
